module brent_kung_adder #(parameter N = 8) (
    input [N-1:0] A,
    input [N-1:0] B,
    output [N-1:0] S,
    output Cout
);
    wire [N:0] C; // Carry wires
    wire [N-1:0] P, G; // Propagate and Generate

    assign G = A & B; // Generate

    genvar i;

    assign Cout = C[N]; // Final carry-out

endmodule

    output reg [6:0] codeword
);

        // Assign data bits
        codeword[2:0] = data; // Data bits d1, d2, d3, d4 are data[3:0]
